summary: Supports experimental projects in construction that challenge conventional methods to advance green transition, increase productivity, and make the sector attractive. Projects should address problems in construction by exploring, testing, and learning, focusing on waste reduction, responsible consumption, resource optimization, innovation, technological development, and improved processes and collaboration. Example project is Insutex, which upcycles textile waste into insulation material.
eligible_applicants: Companies experimenting with new construction methods
reporting_requirements: Project outcomes and learnings from experiments
Results of relevant product tests (e.g., safety and performance tests)
Progress updates regarding innovation and technological development
